title: Heavenly Premium Ski Rental Including Delivery
includes: Hotel drop off and pick up
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Adults are considered 13 years or older
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Delivery service is only for those directly in the South Tahoe (Heavenly, Sierra-at-Tahoe, Kirkwood) area.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Don't waste another minute waiting in line at the rental shops on your next ski vacation. With premium delivery service, you can place your order for skis, snowboards, boots and helmets before you arrive. Your gear will be delivered at a time that’s convenient for you and does a custom fitting while you sit back and relax in your hotel room, condo or vacation home. Returns are just as convenient and easy as delivery.
